The '''X-19 barge''' was produced by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. Two X-19 barges owned by [[Canistel AgriStar]] were lost in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]], and it was believed that the seeds they carried resulted in the spread of the [[senoti]] tress on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].
